description: Inspected raw HTML table with 38 district rows and 72 MultiIndex columns.
Flattened MultiIndex columns into standard strings and prepared lowercase snake_case mappings.
Reshaped 38 district rows across 23 years into 874 standard long records.
Standardized 38 district names to lowercase snake_case while preserving original names.
Calculated yield_kg_ha using (production_tonnes * 1000 / area_ha) without assuming missing production is zero.
Validated non-negative values: negative area=0, negative production=0, negative yield=0.
Detected 4 records where reported yield was 0.0 despite missing production; kept calculated yield as NaN.
Documented missing historical records for newly created districts (e.g. Tenkasi, Chengalpattu, Kallakurichi, Mayiladuthurai, Ranipet, Tirupathur) prior to administrative formation.
